name: Warm Hospitality
signature: Cream and terracotta, friendly display serif, big rounded photo cards, soft shadows.

contrast.note: Light theme. Terracotta is safe as text on both backgrounds. White labels on terracotta buttons pass AA.

motion.rule: Gentle arrival: cards rise 28px and fade in over 800ms, 90ms apart, with a soft ease-out and no overshoot.
use: data-count-to for real years in business

hero.layout: One large photo card with 32px radius filling the container; a warm ink-to-transparent overlay on the bottom 50%; headline and two buttons bottom-left over the overlay; a row of three short real facts under the card.
hero.photo: Real photo of the owners, the shop or the work; warm light preferred.

background: Cream page with alternating peach (surface) sections. A single large soft circle of surface color behind the hero card for depth. No patterns.

button.fill: Accent fill, white label; secondary is an ink outline.
button.label: Body sans, weight 600, sentence case.
button.hover: Lifts 4px with data-lift on hover; shadow is static.
